name: RichTextSkeleton
description: The editor's adaptive toolbar and empty content geometry while the engine or document loads.
signature: ({ minHeight, maxHeight, className, style, }: RichTextSkeletonProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Same content bound as RichTextInput. Default 480 CSS pixels.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Same content height as RichTextInput. Default 160 CSS pixels.

props.name: style
props.description: Outer layout styles, matching the loaded input's layout.
